items.source: Compatible with Hibernate ORM 7.1, as of Spring Framework 7.0. This Hibernate-specific LocalSessionFactoryBean can be an immediate alternative to LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean for common JPA purposes: The Hibernate SessionFactory will natively expose the JPA EntityManagerFactory interface as well, and Hibernate BeanContainer integration will be registered out of the box. In combination with HibernateTransactionManager, this naturally allows for mixing JPA access code with native Hibernate access code within the same transaction.
items.translation: 与 Hibernate ORM 7.1 兼容，自 Spring Framework 7.0 起。此特定于 Hibernate 的LocalSessionFactoryBean可作为LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean的即时替代方案，用于常见的 JPA 目的：Hibernate 的SessionFactory将原生暴露 JPAEntityManagerFactory接口，并且 HibernateBeanContainer集成也将开箱即用。与HibernateTransactionManager结合使用时，这自然允许在同一事务中混合使用 JPA 访问代码和原生 Hibernate 访问代码。

items.source: This will only be applied for an internally built MetadataSources instance. setMetadataSources(MetadataSources) effectively overrides such settings, with integrators to be applied to the externally built MetadataSources.
items.translation: 这仅适用于内部构建的 MetadataSources 实例。setMetadataSources(MetadataSources) 实际上会覆盖此类设置，而集成器将应用于外部构建的 MetadataSources。

items.source: SessionFactory initialization will then switch into background bootstrap mode, with a SessionFactory proxy immediately returned for injection purposes instead of waiting for Hibernate's bootstrapping to complete. However, note that the first actual call to a SessionFactory method will then block until Hibernate's bootstrapping completed, if not ready by then. For maximum benefit, make sure to avoid early SessionFactory calls in init methods of related beans, even for metadata introspection purposes.
items.translation: SessionFactory 初始化随后将切换到后台引导模式，立即返回一个 SessionFactory 代理用于注入目的，而无需等待 Hibernate 的引导完成。然而，请注意，如果此时尚未准备好，对 SessionFactory 方法的首次实际调用将会阻塞，直到 Hibernate 的引导完成。为了获得最大收益，请确保在相关 Bean 的初始化方法中避免早期调用 SessionFactory，即使是为了元数据内省目的。

items.source: Can also be externally called to initialize and pre-populate a MetadataSources instance which is then going to be used for SessionFactory building.
items.translation: 也可从外部调用以初始化并预填充一个 MetadataSources 实例，该实例随后将用于 SessionFactory 的构建。

items.source: Default is to search all specified packages for classes annotated with @jakarta.persistence.Entity, @jakarta.persistence.Embeddable or @jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass.
items.translation: 默认情况下，会在所有指定的包中搜索带有 `@jakarta.persistence.Entity`、`@jakarta.persistence.Embeddable` 或 `@jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass` 注解的类。

items.source: By default, this supports the primary type exposed by the factory, as indicated by FactoryBean.getObjectType(). Specific factories may support additional types for dependency injection.
items.translation: 默认情况下，它支持工厂暴露的主类型，如FactoryBean.getObjectType()所示。特定工厂可能支持用于依赖注入的额外类型。

items.source:
If this is set, the Hibernate settings should not define
a connection provider to avoid meaningless double configuration.
items.translation: 如果设置了此项，Hibernate 配置不应定义连接提供者，以避免无意义的重复配置。

items.source:
Note: If this is set, the Hibernate settings should not define a
cache provider to avoid meaningless double configuration.
items.translation: 注意：如果设置了此项，Hibernate 配置不应定义缓存提供者，以避免无意义的重复配置。

items.source:
Note: Do not specify a transaction provider here when using
Spring-driven transactions. It is also advisable to omit connection
provider settings and use a Spring-set DataSource instead.
items.translation: 注意：在使用 Spring 驱动的事务时，请勿在此指定事务提供者。此外，建议省略连接提供者设置，并使用由 Spring 配置的 DataSource。

items.source:
As of 6.2, Hibernate initialization is enforced before context refresh
completion, waiting for asynchronous bootstrapping to complete by then.
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，Hibernate 初始化将在上下文刷新完成之前强制执行，等待此时异步引导完成。

items.source:
The default implementation invokes LocalSessionFactoryBuilder's buildSessionFactory.
A custom implementation could prepare the instance in a specific way (for example, applying
a custom ServiceRegistry) or use a custom SessionFactoryImpl subclass.
items.translation: 默认实现会调用 `LocalSessionFactoryBuilder` 的 `buildSessionFactory` 方法。自定义实现可以以特定方式准备该实例（例如，应用自定义的 `ServiceRegistry`），或使用自定义的 `SessionFactoryImpl` 子类。

items.source: Accept the containing BeanFactory, registering corresponding Hibernate BeanContainer integration for it if possible. This requires a Spring ConfigurableListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 接受包含的BeanFactory，并在可能的情况下为其注册相应的 HibernateBeanContainer集成。这需要 Spring 的ConfigurableListableBeanFactory。

items.source: Accept the containing BeanFactory, registering corresponding Hibernate BeanContainer integration for it if possible.
items.translation: 接受包含 BeanFactory 的内容，如果可能的话，为其注册相应的 Hibernate BeanContainer 集成。

items.translation: 指定要使用的 Hibernate MetadataSources 服务（例如，重用现有的一个），并可能使用自定义的 Hibernate 引导 ServiceRegistry 对其进行填充。

items.translation: 注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

items.source: FactoryBeans are allowed to return null objects. The bean factory will consider this as a normal value to be used and will not throw a FactoryBeanNotInitializedException in this case. However, FactoryBean implementations are encouraged to throw FactoryBeanNotInitializedException themselves, as appropriate.
items.translation: FactoryBeans 允许返回 `null` 对象。在此情况下，Bean 工厂会将其视为正常值并使用该值，而不会抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。不过，建议 FactoryBean 实现类根据具体情况自行抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。

items.source: As with a BeanFactory, this allows support for both the Singleton and Prototype design patterns.
items.translation: 与BeanFactory一样，这支持单例和原型两种设计模式。

items.source: If this FactoryBean is not fully initialized yet at the time of the call (for example because it is involved in a circular reference), throw a corresponding FactoryBeanNotInitializedException.
items.translation: 如果在此调用时该 FactoryBean 尚未完全初始化（例如因为它涉及循环引用），则抛出相应的 FactoryBeanNotInitializedException。

items.source: NOTE: Autowiring will simply ignore FactoryBeans that return null here. Therefore, it is highly recommended to implement this method properly, using the current state of the FactoryBean.
items.translation: 注意： 自动装配将简单地忽略在此处返回`null`的 FactoryBean。因此，强烈建议使用 FactoryBean 的当前状态正确实现此方法。

items.source: This method can be called before this FactoryBean has been fully initialized. It must not rely on state created during initialization; of course, it can still use such state if available.
items.translation: 此方法可以在该 FactoryBean 完全初始化之前被调用。它不能依赖在初始化期间创建的状态；当然，如果可用，它仍然可以使用此类状态。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
This allows one to check for specific types of beans without
instantiating objects, for example on autowiring.
items.translation: 这允许在例如自动装配时，无需实例化对象即可检查特定类型的 Bean。

items.source:
In the case of implementations that create a singleton object,
this method should try to avoid singleton creation as far as possible;
it should rather estimate the type in advance.
For prototypes, returning a meaningful type here is advisable too.
items.translation: 对于创建单例对象的实现，此方法应尽可能避免创建单例；相反，它应预先估算类型。对于原型对象，在此处返回有意义的类型也是可取的。

items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source:

object that got prepared by this LocalSessionFactoryBean.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法，以通过由该 LocalSessionFactoryBean 准备好的给定 Configuration 对象来执行对 SessionFactory 实例的自定义初始化。

items.translation: 返回由该工厂管理的对象的实例（可能是共享的或独立的）。
